item.title: GitHub Trending Digest — March 2026
item.description: March 2026 was dominated by AI agent frameworks and coding assistants, with OpenClaw leading the charge as a cross-platform AI assistant gaining 20k+ stars. The ecosystem around Claude Code and similar tools exploded with skills, plugins, and orchestration frameworks. Notable trends include multi-agent systems, voice AI, and specialized tools for web scraping and data analysis.
